name: Prove Your Innocence!
desc:
⚖️ YOU'VE BEEN ARRESTED... BUT ARE YOU REALLY GUILTY?

You have 3 DAYS until your trial.

🚔 Get arrested and survive detention  
🔎 Find evidence that could save your case  
🗣️ Watch what you say during interrogations  
👨‍⚖️ Build your defense with your lawyer  
🏀 Explore the prison and uncover secrets  
⚖️ Face the judge, witnesses, and jury  
🎁 Earn Justice Stars and unlock permanent Case Items  
🏆 Discover multiple different endings!

Every decision can come back during your trial.

Will you prove your innocence... or make everything worse?

llm.loop: get arrested -> survive 3 days of detention -> find evidence and handle interrogations -> face trial -> reach one of multiple endings
llm.objectives: prove your innocence at trial and unlock all endings
llm.progression: Justice Stars, permanent case items, endings
llm.instructions: find evidence, watch what you say, build defense, face judge and jury
unique: courtroom trial story with choices that come back at the trial
llm.thumbnails: cartoon courtroom, arrest scene, judge shouting GUILTY
llm.complexity_notes: multiple scenes, branching dialogue and endings
